name: Kir-hareseth
line: Kir-hareseth was a walled city and fortress of Moab, the last Moabite city left standing when Israel invaded, and a place the prophet Isaiah mourned.

moments.title: The last city standing
moments.text: Israel destroyed the Moabite cities, covered the good fields with stones, stopped up the springs, and cut down the good trees. Only Kir-hareseth was left with its stones in place, but men with slings surrounded it and attacked it too.

moments.title: The king's desperate offering
moments.text: The king of Moab could not break through the enemy lines. He offered his firstborn son as a burnt offering on the city wall, and great fury came against the Israelites, so they withdrew and went home.

moments.title: Isaiah's message about Kir-hareseth
moments.text: Isaiah's message spoke of Moab's pride and empty boasting. It called on Moab to wail and moan for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth, and said his heart laments for the city like a harp.
